purpose: A two-record, outcome-blind, categorical currency-side bridge family. It does not assert classical financial doctrine, pair direction, price direction, magnitude, confidence, or execution.

entries.author: CENTRAL_RESEARCH_AUTHORIZATION
entries.sourceClaim: The frozen source/operator record supplies a categorical compound relationship state for an eligible transit-body to natal-target pair. It does not supply a currency or market conclusion.
entries.experimentalClaim: For this outcome-blind USD-side pilot only, FRIEND-family compound states are hypothesized as SUPPORTIVE USD pressure, ENEMY-family states as ADVERSE USD pressure, and NEUTRAL as categorical NEUTRAL.
entries.reasoning: The direct compound-relationship state is the sole centrally authorized S2 bridge predicate. No other source operator can override, reverse, weight, or complete it.
experimentalAssumptions: The frozen transit-to-natal compound-relationship output is the authorized S2 input context.
Relational valence is hypothesized to transfer in the same semantic direction to the affected USD side.
GREAT_FRIEND and FRIEND collapse to the same categorical SUPPORTIVE state.
GREAT_ENEMY and ENEMY collapse to the same categorical ADVERSE state.
NEUTRAL is categorical and is not numeric zero.
Unavailable compound relationship data requires abstention without fallback.
prohibitedGeneralizations: This does not claim that classical sources predict USD or any market.
This does not imply USDJPY pair direction.
This does not make benefic, malefic, aspect, dignity, bala, motion, or modifier states sign inputs.
This does not configure a signed unit, magnitude, confidence, weight, or amplitude.
This does not establish financial validation, accuracy, edge, expectancy, or profitability.
This does not create a production rule, Auto Suggest rule, ML label, MT5 path, or execution path.
